player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in the Negotiation Game.
You have some resources, and your task is to trade such that the total value of your resources increases.
The resources and associated values you currently have are:
	+ {resource_value_list}
At each turn, you can talk to your opponent and make a trade offer.
Use the following special tokens for actions:
  - '[Offer: 3 Sheep, 2 Ore -> 5 Brick, 2 Sheep]': [Offer: Offered Resources -> Requested Resources]
  - '[Accept]': To accept an incoming offer.
  - '[Deny]': To deny an incoming offer (default).
The game lasts for {max_turns} turns in total.

invalid_move.receiving_with_no_resource: Uyu muntu alefwaya ukusenda uyu mwiminishi ukwabula ukukwata indalama sha kushitamo.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Player {player_id}, Kuchita kosa. Koloni {col} ikalamba ukuboko.
invalid_move.proposing_with_no_resource: Umwina {player_id} aeseshe ukupeela insambu sha kushitamo ukwabula ukukwata ifyuma.
invalid_move.incorrect_offer_format: Umulashi {player_id} alilembele ifyo alefwaya ukubwekeshapo mu nshila yabipa.
invalid_move.no_new_offer: Umulashi {player_id} taile mu kucita icipangano cipya.

offers.accept: Player {acceptor_id} alikubali kufanya biashara na Player {proposer_id}.
offers.proposal: Player {player_id} alitoa ofa kwa Player {opponent_id}: Vifaa vilivyotolewa: {offered} -> Vifaa vinavyohitajika: {requested}

outcome.win: Umulashi {winner_id} alicimfishe pa kukwata umutengo wa fintu ifingi.
outcome.draw: Ukupusanako kwa fintu fyonse ifyalipo kuli bonse abaleteya.
